g.text: One hasher chip trace. Rows are a public schedule; everything non-local is a linear claim.
one row is one valid compression
Dense relations — the cell hash chain
each chunk feeds the next, row to row
global linear identities over a public schedule
Parity check — the row low-degree test
reads the same limbs the Cell rows absorb
Σᵢ αⁱ ( Σⱼ sL[j]·Cᵢ[2j] − Σⱼ sR[j]·Cᵢ[2j+1] ) = 0
claim = AIR + η · cell_link + η² · sparse_linear
